name: tp_dtp
description: Fig.2 optimizer comparison on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10: ER Algorithm 0 vs Algorithm 1 and gradient baselines with the existing long-run optimization-step budgets.

notes.logging: step 0 initialization; steps 1..9; 10,20,..,90; 100,200,...; final always retained
notes.data: PROJECT/data; complete train/test tensors are preloaded to the target device once per run
notes.wall_clock: one synchronized timer from before step-0 evaluation through final evaluation; reported as total and total/optimization_steps
notes.er_variants: er0 = fixed corrected-state regressors (Algorithm 0); er1 = sequential realized forward recomputation (Algorithm 1).
notes.budget_revision_20260904: All Fig.2 optimizer max_steps doubled relative to the previous sweep.

fashionmnist.rationale: Same 60,000-sample, 784-dimensional geometry as MNIST; use the MNIST Fig.2 budgets for a matched comparison.

notes.fig2_datasets_20260907: Added Fashion-MNIST as the middle Fig.2 panel; 10 seeds per optimizer.
